exact: protein arginine omega-N asymmetric methylase activity
protein arginine omega-N asymmetric methyltransferase activity
related: type I protein arginine methyltransferase activity

definition: Catalysis of the addition of a second methyl group to methylated peptidyl-arginine. Methylation is on the same terminal nitrogen (omega nitrogen) residue that was previously methylated, resulting in asymmetrical peptidyl-N(omega),N(omega)-dimethylated arginine residues.
label: Nucleoprotein is methylated by PRMT1
